# Explain a technology

You explain one technology in the chat, tied to where this project's specs use it. You read the specs and say what they show. You change nothing. You write nothing unless the user asks to save (1.192.0).

This is cross-cutting. It is not its own lane and can run any time. It does not move work into Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not `$crav1-explain-this-code` (one piece of code) and not `$crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this` (everything known about one thing).

## Input

Everything after `$crav1-explain-tech`: `[deeper] [save] <technology> [in <spec, design topic, or architecture>]`. For example `$crav1-explain-tech Service Bus`, `$crav1-explain-tech deeper Private Link in orders-api`.

When no technology is named, ask which one and stop until the user answers. A headless or bot run with no technology stops and says: `Missing technology. Name one, for example: $crav1-explain-tech Service Bus.`

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs. There are no `--flags`.

- Depth: `deeper` (the default is the short answer).
- Save: `save` (append a note to the spec's notes file).

`route --text "<words>"` splits the words into `tech`, `scope`, `deeper` and `save`.

## Reading

Run `<interpreter> scripts/explain_tech.py --root <specs repo> find --tech "<technology>" [--scope <spec|topic|architecture>] --vendor codex`, where the interpreter is `py -3` on Windows and `python3` elsewhere (`crav1-docs/reference/running-scripts.md`). Add `--alias` for another name of the same thing, for example `--alias "Azure Service Bus"`. It reads specs, plans, tasks and notes under `docs/specs/`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, its ADRs, design topics under `docs/architecture/designs/` (read-only, and each shown as under discussion, not decided: `decided: false`), and `docs/system/`, and returns each mention with its file, line, section and a link (`path#section`), plus `owners` and `save_to`.

Read the sections it names before you write. Links in the answer come only from `find`; never write a spec link it did not return. Read-only: `find` and `check` write nothing.

## The answer

Follow [references/answer.md](references/answer.md) for the fixed shape, the word counts, the not-in-spec path, and who has missing facts. `check --input <answer.md> [--deeper]` tests the shape, the word count and every link; write the draft in the session's temp folder.

## Save

Only when the user asked: the word `save`, or yes on the card offered at the end. Follow [references/save.md](references/save.md).

Card: Save this explanation to the spec's notes?
- **Save it (Recommended)** (`yes`): append a dated Technology notes entry with the short explanation and its links to the spec's notes file. Why: the next reader finds it next to the spec.
- **Not now** (`not-now`): write nothing; the answer stays in the chat.

## Stop

Do not change a spec, a plan, a task, a design topic or an ADR. Do not run another skill; naming one in Run next is not running it. Never tell the user to edit a spec file by hand.

## Run ending (1.122.0)

End as [run-ending.md](../crav1-docs/reference/run-ending.md) says, with the Run next from `ending --tech "<technology>" [--deeper] [--not-in-spec] [--spec <slug>] [--saved <path>]`.
